releaseNotes:
• Persistent DesktopCaptureSession with GDI handle reuse and zero-copy frame pipeline
• Decoupled DesktopStreamSurface on Android eliminating Compose tree recomposition at 60 FPS
• Adaptive backpressure frame pacing modulating quality (45-75) and interval (16-33ms)
• Direct low-latency TCP socket streaming engine with zero OkHttp pooling drops
• Screen fill default display scaling (zero black bars) with 1-tap HUD scaling toggle
• Direct Connect flow in Devices tab with automatic SMP session creation
